_doc: Turbo gameplay tuning knobs for FC27.exe build 6AC07E31-2145C000 (turbogui/src/core/tuning.h), version 4 (2.4, docs/TACTICS_OVERHAUL_DECISION.md 3.1).
Source: turbo_output\TACTICS_MOD_CATALOGUE.txt sections 2, 4, 6 and 7 (FC 27 type data), the 2026-10-13 read-only locate run
(ATTRIBULATOR_LIVE.json) and the offline sweep T5 (layout_T5.json: family and group slots from the image's reflection data). collection =
the attribulator group, field = the reflected field name, offset = its offset in the group's type, default = FC 27's own value
(copy_defaults: a database copy whose FC 27 value differs). min / max are Turbo's generic safety bounds. No gameplay mod's values.
attrib_manager: the deterministic locate. The signature attrib_db_getter (get_current_gameplay_attribdb) resolves the manager slot G;
[G] = the manager; [[mgr+0]+8] = the current gameplay database; [[mgr+prematch_slot]+8] = the prematch database (every manager slot is
tried when that one does not hold it); every gameplay database (gameplay_dbs) is enumerated once per session from the heap slots holding
its TypeInfo. A locator with db_type / family_slot / group_slot is reached through the databases: +family_slot the group object
(group_type), +group_slot the instance; its copies are the distinct instances, matched to the variants by Name (variant db = the
database the name search uses for the cross-check / fallback). Identity per instance: vtable (head_rva), TypeInfo -> type name,
signature, size, field count, Name, GUID; a mismatch refuses the group for the session.
A knob or locator with 'verified': false is shown as 'not yet working on this build' and never written. when = the moments the tuning
profile writes the knob at (boot, career_load, hub); live: true also allows prematch / match (only after gate X1 shows a live effect).
proof = {session, evidence}: the in-game measurement of the knob's effect (P-sessions); only a proven knob is a slider in the view, the
others are read-only rows 'located, effect not proven'. slider: true without a proof is refused by scripts/package.sh --guard.
note: v4 (2.4): located through the attribute manager (attrib_manager, no memory search for the chain); the profile's moments (boot, career_load, hub); FC 27 defaults only; no knob proven yet (every knob read-only until a P-session adds its proof)

attrib_manager.note: G = 0x14C26B128 on 6AC07E31 [V live]; [[mgr+0]+8] = the current gameplay database [V live]; mgr+0x8 = the prematch handle [A, T5 2.2: the only reader of mgr+8 in the build 6AB9813C image walks it to pm_formation]; i32 mgr+0x18 = the current database index [V old image]

knobs.label: Team width with the ball
knobs.notes: How wide the team spreads out when it has the ball. 1.00 = FC 27; higher = wider.

knobs.label: Centre-back split with the ball
knobs.notes: How far apart the centre-backs split when the team builds up. 1.00 = FC 27; higher = wider.

knobs.label: Team length with the ball (balanced build-up)
knobs.notes: Distance from the back line to the front line when attacking with the balanced build-up. Higher = a longer, more stretched team.

knobs.label: Team length with the ball (possession build-up)
knobs.notes: The same for the possession (short passing) build-up. Higher = a longer, more stretched team.

knobs.label: Team width without the ball
knobs.notes: How wide the team defends. 1.00 = FC 27; lower = narrower, more compact. Not yet confirmed in the running game: shown, never written.

knobs.label: Team length without the ball
knobs.notes: Distance from the back line to the front line when defending (balanced build-up). Lower = a shorter, more compact block. Not yet confirmed in the running game: shown, never written.

knobs.label: Gap between the back line and the holding midfielders
knobs.notes: Metres between the defensive line and the holding-midfield line when defending, ball level with the lines. Lower = tighter lines. Not yet confirmed in the running game: shown, never written.

knobs.label: Gap between the back line and the holding midfielders (ball deep)
knobs.notes: The same gap while the ball is deep in your half. Not yet confirmed in the running game: shown, never written.

knobs.label: Gap to the midfield line (ball deep)
knobs.notes: Metres from the defensive line to the midfield line (formations with holding midfielders) while the ball is deep in your half. Not yet confirmed in the running game: shown, never written.

knobs.label: Depth at which the back line holds
knobs.notes: The tactic depth (0..1) at which the back line switches to holding its height instead of dropping with the play. What a change does in a match is not measured yet. Not yet confirmed in the running game: shown, never written.

knobs.label: Deep: up to depth
knobs.notes: A club's Defensive Depth (1..100, in its tactic) picks one of four defensive styles: Deep, Balanced, High, Aggressive. These bands say where each style starts and ends (FC 27: Deep 1-30, Balanced 31-60, High 61-90, Aggressive 91-100). Moving a band moves the line height of every club whose depth falls in it; read when a match is set up.

knobs.label: Pressing starts at depth
knobs.notes: Tactic depth (0..1) from which the team presses in zones. Lower = the team presses earlier and more often. Not yet confirmed in the running game: shown, never written.

knobs.label: Zone marking starts at depth
knobs.notes: Tactic depth from which defenders mark zones instead of holding the line. Lower = zone marking starts earlier. Not yet confirmed in the running game: shown, never written.

knobs.label: No double marking when pressing in your own half
knobs.notes: On: when the team presses in its own half, two players do not close down the same opponent. FC 27 has it on in the base database and off in Authentic (simulation); one switch writes both. Not yet confirmed in the running game: shown, never written.

knobs.notes: How closely players stay on the opponent they mark. Higher = tighter. Not yet confirmed in the running game: shown, never written.

knobs.label: How often players make runs
